content:
Amazon's autumn early Prime Day mega-sale is in full swing, with thousands of products already discounted. While more Apple products will join the discount lineup next week, we've already seen the AirTag 2 hit a historic low price, the M5 Pro MacBook Pro drop by $500 USD, multiple MacBook Air models discounted by up to $150 USD, and discounts on some of Apple's latest products.

All of the above offers, plus smart TV discounts of up to $1,200 USD, a huge selection of MagSafe chargers and power banks, Amazon smart speakers and displays, smart home upgrades, and more — all up to 50% off. Please read on for more details, and remember — we'll keep updating this article until next week.
